stories.title: Anticorrupción investiga filtración de 12.9 millones de registros de datos personales; se atribuye a call centers

en.title: Anti-corruption office investigates leak of 12.9 million personal data records attributed to call centers
en.summary: Mexico's anti-corruption agency is investigating a data breach affecting 12.9 million records containing personal information including names, birth dates, addresses, and bank details, allegedly originating from call center operations.

stories.title: Sentencian a 78 años de cárcel a responsables de secuestrar y matar al niño Fernando en Edomex; su madre no pudo pagar deuda de mil pesos

en.title: Perpetrators sentenced to 78 years prison for kidnapping and killing child Fernando in State of Mexico; his mother unable to pay 1,000 peso debt
en.summary: Individuals convicted in connection with the kidnapping and death of a child in the State of Mexico received 78-year sentences. Prosecutors determined the child was abducted to pressure his mother into paying an outstanding debt.

stories.title: Embajada de EU en México reitera alerta por huracán Polo; advierte por lluvias intensas y fuertes vientos

en.title: U.S. Embassy in Mexico reiterates alert for Hurricane Polo; warns of heavy rainfall and strong winds
en.summary: The U.S. Embassy in Mexico issued a weather alert regarding Hurricane Polo, warning of intense rainfall and strong winds while urging residents to follow local authority guidance.

stories.title: Jorge Romero se come un pejelagarto en visita a Tabasco; cuestiona acciones de Morena y asegura que "le van a dar duro"

en.title: Jorge Romero eats a pejelagarto during visit to Tabasco; questions Morena actions and asserts they "will come at him hard"
en.summary: A PAN politician visited Tabasco, engaging in local activities while criticizing Morena's actions and stating the party seeks to strengthen dialogue with citizens.

stories.title: Muere uno tras explosión de pirotecnia; hay 10 heridos

en.title: One dies after fireworks explosion; 10 injured
en.summary: A vehicle carrying fireworks exploded in San Francisco Tepojaco, Mexico State, killing one person and injuring ten others.

stories.title: Ambulancia del IMSS choca contra varios vehículos y atropella a joven en Azcapotzalco; conductor es detenido

en.title: IMSS ambulance crashes into multiple vehicles and hits young person in Azcapotzalco; driver detained
en.summary: An IMSS ambulance collided with nine other vehicles and struck a young person in Azcapotzalco, leading to the driver's arrest.

stories.title: CNN denuncia que la Casa Blanca incumple una orden judicial; periodistas enfrentan restricciones para cubrir a Xi

en.title: CNN reports White House violates court order; journalists face restrictions covering Xi
en.summary: CNN alleges the White House is not complying with a judge's order to restore media access, with journalists experiencing restrictions while covering Xi's presence.

stories.title: Colombia rompe relaciones diplomáticas con Irán

en.title: Colombia breaks diplomatic relations with Iran
en.summary: Colombia severed diplomatic relations with Iran, citing Tehran's actions in Middle Eastern conflicts including the Strait of Hormuz blockade and regional attacks as damaging to trust.

stories.title: Colombia rompe relaciones con Irán; denuncia presuntos vínculos con "grupos narcoterroristas"

en.title: Colombia breaks relations with Iran; denounces alleged links with "narcoterrorist groups"
en.summary: Colombia terminated diplomatic relations with Iran and designated Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organization, citing concerns about repression of the population and alleged connections to narcoterrorist groups.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW y Politico vuelven a la Casa Blanca tras una orden judicial

en.title: CNN, MS Now and Politico return to the White House following court order
en.summary: A judicial decision restored White House access for CNN, MS Now, and Politico journalists six days after President Trump revoked their credentials, allowing them to resume reporting from the building.

stories.title: Conduce ebrio ambulancia del IMSS y choca en Azcapotzalco

en.title: Intoxicated ambulance operator crashes in Azcapotzalco
en.summary: An IMSS ambulance operator drove while under the influence of alcohol, struck a pedestrian, and collided with multiple vehicles in Mexico City's Azcapotzalco neighborhood.

stories.title: México despliega casi 20,000 efectivos en estados afectados por coletazo de huracán Polo

en.title: Mexico deploys nearly 20,000 personnel in states affected by Hurricane Polo's aftermath
en.summary: Mexico deployed almost 20,000 troops to states impacted by Hurricane Polo, which caused significant damage including strong waves affecting Lázaro Cárdenas, a major port and industrial city in southern Michoacán.

stories.title: México reabre segundo cruce para exportar ganado a EU; CNA exige más recursos sanitarios

en.title: Mexico reopens second crossing to export cattle to US; CNA demands more sanitary resources
en.summary: Mexico reopened a second border crossing for cattle exports to the United States, initially allowing 800 head daily with increases to 1,500 by week four. The sanitary authority requested budget increases and additional resources to support the operation.

stories.title: ¿Cuánto cuesta acceder a preventas? Tarjetas de crédito se convierten en requisito para comprar boletos de conciertos

en.title: How much does pre-sale access cost? Credit cards become a requirement to buy concert tickets
en.summary: Concert pre-sales increasingly require specific credit cards as a practical requirement for accessing tickets, turning card ownership into a barrier for attendance.

stories.title: ¿Tu teléfono te escucha? Esta función de Google puede guardar tus grabaciones de voz

en.title: Is your phone listening to you? This Google feature can save your voice recordings
en.summary: A little-known Google Account setting allows storage of audio recordings from voice searches and interactions, and users can check whether this feature is enabled.

stories.title: Por inflación, gasolinas, refrescos y cigarros incrementarán IEPS en 2027

en.title: Due to inflation, gasoline, soft drinks and cigarettes will increase excise taxes in 2027
en.summary: Mexico will adjust special taxes on gasoline, diesel, soft drinks and cigarettes in 2027 based on inflation recorded in December 2026, estimated at 3.8% annually.

stories.title: La adopción del streaming crece en zonas rurales mientras que en zonas urbanas empieza a moderarse

en.title: Streaming adoption grows in rural areas while moderating in urban zones
en.summary: The shift of sports and entertainment content from traditional television to digital platforms is driving streaming adoption in rural areas, while growth slows in urban regions.
